description: This file defines the login page component for the frontend of an event management system, including server handlers for login logic, session handling, and rendering the login form.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Redirects an authenticated user to '/events' if a token cookie is present; otherwise, returns an empty json object.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles login form submission, authenticates via API, sets session token cookie, and redirects to '/events'.
